# OpenBin.ai

> OpenBin is an open-source, BYOK, self-hosted platform for AI-assisted reverse engineering. It pairs traditional binary-analysis tooling (JADX, Ghidra) with an agent layer driven by the user's own LLM credentials - so the agent does the grunt work of reading decompiled code, tracing call chains, and drafting reports, while the binary and the analyst's notes never leave the user's infrastructure.

OpenBin is licensed AGPL-3.0. There is no SaaS edition; everyone runs their own instance. The platform is multi-product: each binary format gets its own workspace (today: OpenAPK for Android), but they all share a common core (auth, symbol indexing, agent layer, report engine, BYOK credential storage with KEK-encrypted secrets).

The agent layer supports any of three providers - Anthropic, OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock - with per-user token budgets and a full audit log of every LLM call. Keys are encrypted at rest with a key-encryption key the operator supplies; nothing phones home.

## Available now

- [OpenAPK.ai](https://openapk.ai/): Android APK reverse engineering. JADX-powered decompile, Ghidra-powered native-lib analysis, AI-driven static analysis, call chain tracing with AI-narrated summaries, crypto and obfuscation decoder detection, screenshot capture + annotation, customizable MAR (Malware Analysis Report) and VRR (Vulnerability Research Report) templates.

## Coming soon

- OpenPE: Windows PE / DLL analysis - same agent layer, Ghidra under the hood.
- OpenELF: Linux ELF binaries + firmware images.
- OpenIPA: iOS app bundles - IPAs, Mach-O, Swift symbol recovery.
- OpenWASM: WebAssembly modules - supply-chain auditing for the browser.

## Key concepts

- **Agent-native**: the UI is built around an LLM agent that reads code and writes reports. Not a chatbot bolted onto a traditional decompiler.
- **BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: every user supplies their own API credentials for Anthropic / OpenAI / AWS Bedrock. The platform never centralizes LLM spend.
- **Self-hosted**: runs in Docker on the operator's infrastructure. Air-gap-friendly. No telemetry.
- **Reversible**: renames, decompiles, and report edits are all reversible from the UI. Nothing the agent does touches the operator's filesystem unless explicitly permitted.
- **Open core**: source code is AGPL-3.0 on GitHub.

## Project resources

- [Landing page](https://openbin.ai/): platform overview.

## Glossary

- **MAR**: Malware Analysis Report - section-templated report optimised for malware triage (sample overview, static findings, IOCs, recommendations, analyst notes).
- **VRR**: Vulnerability Research Report - section-templated report optimised for vuln research (target, attack surface, auth/storage, network, vulnerabilities with CWE + severity, repro, remediation).
- **KEK**: Key Encryption Key - the operator-supplied AES-256 master key used to wrap per-user LLM credentials at rest.
- **JADX**: Java decompiler used to extract Android source from APK / DEX. Embedded in OpenAPK; not a separate microservice.
- **Ghidra**: NSA-released reverse engineering framework, used by OpenAPK in a containerised worker microservice to decompile native (.so) libraries to pseudo-C.
